summary: Seven of twenty base records pass all screens (Multifamily/Tampa, closed 2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31, <=8 mi, 78-174 units, stabilized, single-asset, fee-simple, unrelated-party, known positive price, 'unit' size unit); one of those (R4477) is a duplicate of R5709. The five nearest qualifying unique sales are R5709 (0.80 mi, $291,667/unit), R1935 (1.03 mi, $316,019/unit after executed amendment U-R1935-1), R8685 (1.26 mi, $292,727/unit), R1029 (1.49 mi, $290,678/unit) and R4639 (1.72 mi, $291,200/unit). Observed range is roughly $290.7K-$316.0K per unit, average ~$296.5K. R5751 (1.95 mi) and R9886 (2.18 mi) are eligible back-ups outside the top five. All prices normalized to USD from USD_thousands/USD_millions; U-R1029-3 (unsigned draft) and U-R8685-2 (published 2026-09-10) were correctly disregarded.
limitations: R1935's price relies on a single executed amendment effective 2026-08-20; no confirming second source in the packet.

R8685 has a post-cutoff executed amendment (U-R8685-2) reducing consideration to USD 1; if evaluated after that effective date the comp would fail the known-positive-consideration test and the fifth slot would shift to R5751.
R3929 price is unknown (null), not zero; it could qualify if consideration were later evidenced.

No income, cap-rate, occupancy, vintage or unit-mix data supplied, so no adjustments for age, quality or condition beyond the stated 'stabilized' flag were possible; the Assumptions sheet inputs are left explicitly blank/unknown.
Distances are as-reported straight-line values in the extracts and were not independently verified.
R4477 duplicates R5709 with identical facts; if the two were distinct assets the ranking would change, but the packet labels R4477 as a second source of the same underlying record.
